title: How is Hitler linked to Taylor Swift?
description:
Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Taylor Swift: Romania's dictator and its young king, a Kremlin Victory Day, cheeseburgers with Obama, and Meryl Streep's Medal of Freedom.

Adolf Hitler → Ion Antonescu → Michael I of Romania → Dmitry Medvedev → Barack Obama → Meryl Streep → Taylor Swift

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Ion Antonescu: In the 1940s, Hitler hosted his ally, Romania's dictator Ion Antonescu.
   Photo by US National Archives (NARA 242-HB-48400-908), via US Holocaust Memorial Museum, Public domain: https://collections.ushmm.org/search/catalog/pa12403
2. Ion Antonescu → King Michael: In 1941, Antonescu stood at the front beside Romania's young King Michael.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signal_16-1941..jpg
3. King Michael → Dmitry Medvedev: In 2010, an elderly King Michael visited Russia's Dmitry Medvedev at the Kremlin.
   Photo by Presidential Press and Information Office, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dmitry_Medvedev_greetings_9_May_2010-26.jpg
4. Dmitry Medvedev → Barack Obama: That year, Barack Obama took Medvedev out for cheeseburgers in Virginia.
   Photo by Presidential Press and Information Office, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dmitry_Medvedev_in_the_United_States_24_June_2010-10.jpeg
5. Barack Obama → Meryl Streep: In 2014, Obama gave Meryl Streep the Presidential Medal of Freedom.
   Photo by US Government/Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_presents_the_Presidential_Medal_of_Freedom_to_Meryl_Streep_November_2014.jpg
6. Meryl Streep → Taylor Swift: And in 2014, Streep's co-star at The Giver's premiere was Taylor Swift.
   Photo by aphrodite-in-nyc, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_cast_of_The_Giver_August_2014.jpg

Research notes: Taylor Swift's free photos with famous people are rare, so the route ends at The Giver's 2014 premiere with Meryl Streep instead of the press photo of Prince William's 2013 gala; Romania's King Michael, who lived until 2017, carries it from the war to 2010.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #taylorswift #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
